purpose: First all-species headless ecosystem candidate. No rescue rules. This file contains only integration-specific parameters; species physiology/lifecycle parameters remain in phase2-phase6 fixtures.
notes: Initial counts, clonal timings, movement rates and decomposition multipliers are bounded engineering calibration inputs. Spatial habitat is 60x30 substrate cells across the 120x60 cm footprint (~2 cm/cell). Movement event rates are scaled by the square of the cell-size ratio so the diffusive physical displacement remains comparable to the earlier 10 cm grid; spatial integration samples net random-walk displacement over each ecological timestep. These are not biological population-density claims. Full-ecosystem invariant tolerance is explicitly looser than kernel tests to account for floating-point accumulation over millions of conservative transfers; it remains sub-part-per-billion relative.
